key_insight: PAIR-IBD quantified spatial inflammation and crypt architecture differences between pathologist-defined active ulcerative colitis and histological remission.
clinical_relevance: The system could complement pathology scoring and help characterize inconclusive biopsies, pending further validation.
method: Trained a deep-learning ensemble on three inflammatory bowel disease datasets.
Identified inflammatory cells and segmented mucosal compartments to quantify cell densities, crypt injury and epithelial damage.
Compared AI measurements with pathologist-defined disease activity and manual scores.
evidence_signal: In a single clinical network, active biopsies had 5.3-fold higher crypt neutrophil density than Nancy-defined remission, while selected AI metrics correlated with manual scores (Spearman rs=0.50–0.73).
watch_item: Single-network evaluation limits generalizability; independent validation is needed before clinical implementation.
paper_title: Spatial AI quantification of inflammatory and architectural features differentiates pathologist-defined active ulcerative colitis from histological remission
